quantization.title: Model Quantization Techniques
quantization.description: This module provides a collection of quantization methods for optimizing model size and inference speed. It includes various bit-width quantizers and integrations with specialized libraries for different hardware and frameworks.

nodes.label: HfQuantizer Base Class
nodes.title: Base Quantizer Interface
nodes.description: Provides a common interface and base functionality for all quantization methods, handling environment validation and model processing hooks.

nodes.label: BitNet 1.58-bit Quantizer
nodes.title: BitNet 1.58-bit Quantization
nodes.description: Implements 1.58-bit quantization from the BitNet method, converting linear layers to BitLinear during model loading for extreme compression.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes 4-bit Quantizer
nodes.title: BitsAndBytes 4-bit Quantization
nodes.description: Applies 4-bit quantization using the bitsandbytes library, optimizing memory usage for large models while maintaining reasonable performance.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes 8-bit Quantizer
nodes.title: BitsAndBytes 8-bit Quantization
nodes.description: Applies 8-bit quantization using the bitsandbytes library, balancing precision and memory efficiency for model deployment.

nodes.label: Fine-Grained FP8 Quantizer
nodes.title: Fine-Grained FP8 Quantization
nodes.description: Supports FP8 quantization for standard and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, leveraging GPU capabilities for high-performance inference.

nodes.label: FP-Quant Quantizer
nodes.title: FP-Quant Method Implementation
nodes.description: Handles the FP-Quant method for both pre-quantized models and on-the-fly quantization, requiring specific hardware like Blackwell GPUs for real quantization.

nodes.label: Metal Affine Quantizer
nodes.title: Metal Quantization for Apple Silicon
nodes.description: Utilizes Metal kernels for low-bit (2/4/8) affine quantization on Apple Silicon (MPS) devices, enabling efficient inference on Apple hardware.

nodes.label: MXFP4 Quantizer
nodes.title: MXFP4 Quantization with FBGEMM
nodes.description: Performs FP4 quantization using fbgemm kernels, supporting various hardware with Triton integration for optimized performance.

nodes.label: Quark Quantizer
nodes.title: Quark Quantization Integration
nodes.description: Integrates the Quark library for quantization, managing separate quantizers for weights, inputs, and biases for AMD-specific optimizations.

nodes.label: SINQ Quantizer
nodes.title: SINQ Quantization Methods
nodes.description: Implements SINQ (weight-only) and A-SINQ (activation-aware) quantization, with specific handling for model loading and serialization processes.

nodes.label: TorchAo Quantizer
nodes.title: TorchAo Quantization Integration
nodes.description: Provides quantization capabilities through the PyTorch/torchao library, supporting various quantization schemes and tensor subclass handling.

nodes.label: Weight Conversion Utility
nodes.title: Model Weight Conversion
nodes.description: Manages the conversion and deserialization of model weights, crucial for loading pre-quantized models and adapting them to the quantized format.

nodes.label: Accelerate Library
nodes.title: Hugging Face Accelerate
nodes.description: Facilitates distributed training and mixed-precision operations, often a prerequisite for quantization methods to run efficiently.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes Library
nodes.title: BitsAndBytes
nodes.description: Optimizes memory and speed for large models through 4-bit and 8-bit quantization, widely used for LLM deployment.

nodes.label: PyTorch Library
nodes.title: PyTorch
nodes.description: The foundational deep learning framework providing tensor operations, automatic differentiation, and model definitions.

nodes.label: Qutlass Library
nodes.title: Qutlass
nodes.description: A specialized library required for real FP-Quant quantization, particularly on Blackwell GPUs, enabling hardware-accelerated operations.

nodes.label: FP-Quant Library
nodes.title: FP-Quant
nodes.description: Provides the core implementation for the FP-Quant quantization method, used for both pseudo and real quantization.

nodes.label: Kernels Library
nodes.title: Optimized Kernels
nodes.description: Offers optimized Metal kernels for efficient low-bit quantization on Apple Silicon, enhancing performance on MPS devices.

nodes.label: Triton Library
nodes.title: Triton
nodes.description: Enables writing high-performance custom GPU kernels, used in MXFP4 quantization for specialized tensor operations.

nodes.label: Quark Library
nodes.title: AMD Quark
nodes.description: AMD's library for model quantization, focusing on efficient deployment and hardware-specific optimizations.

nodes.label: SINQ Library
nodes.title: SINQ
nodes.description: A dedicated library for SINQ and A-SINQ quantization techniques, providing specialized modules and operations.

nodes.label: TorchAo Library
nodes.title: PyTorch TorchAo
nodes.description: PyTorch's advanced quantization toolkit, offering various quantization algorithms and integration with PyTorch's ecosystem.

groups.title: Core Quantization Components

groups.label: BitsAndBytes Quantizers
groups.title: BitsAndBytes Quantizers
groups.description: Quantization methods leveraging the BitsAndBytes library for 4-bit and 8-bit model compression.

groups.label: Floating Point Quantizers
groups.title: Floating Point Quantizers
groups.description: Quantization techniques based on various floating-point formats, including FP8, FP-Quant, and MXFP4.

groups.label: Specialized Quantizers
groups.title: Specialized Quantizers
groups.description: A collection of unique quantization methods, often integrating with specific libraries or targeting particular hardware architectures.

external_integrations.title: External Integrations Module
external_integrations.description: This module provides interfaces and callbacks for integrating Hugging Face models and training processes with various external tools and libraries. It supports hyperparameter search with Weights & Biases, experiment logging with DVCLive, and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) adapter management.

nodes.label: Wandb Hyperparameter Backend
nodes.title: Wandb Hyperparameter Search
nodes.description: Provides an interface for integrating with Weights & Biases (Wandb) to perform hyperparameter optimization. It enables running search trials and defining parameter spaces for model training.

nodes.label: DVCLive Logging Callback
nodes.title: DVCLive Experiment Logging
nodes.description: A callback for the Trainer that sends training metrics, parameters, and optionally model checkpoints to DVCLive for experiment tracking, visualization, and data versioning.

nodes.label: PEFT Adapter Management
nodes.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
nodes.description: Enables loading, adding, activating, deactivating, and deleting Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) adapters, such as LoRA, into a base model for efficient model customization.

nodes.label: Weights & Biases (Wandb)
nodes.title: Wandb Platform
nodes.description: An external platform used for experiment tracking, visualization, and hyperparameter optimization in machine learning projects.

nodes.label: DVCLive
nodes.title: DVCLive Experiment Tracking
nodes.description: An external open-source library for experiment tracking, metric logging, and data versioning, often used in conjunction with DVC.

nodes.label: PEFT Library
nodes.title: PEFT Library for Adapters
nodes.description: An external Python library that provides implementations for various Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods, allowing efficient adaptation of large pre-trained models.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Trainer
nodes.title: Model Training Orchestrator
nodes.description: The core component responsible for orchestrating the training and evaluation loops of Hugging Face models, managing callbacks, and applying training arguments.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Model
nodes.title: Base Transformer Model
nodes.description: A pre-trained or custom transformer model that can be fine-tuned or adapted using various techniques, including PEFT adapters.
